fixtureGoal: Capture the human release handoff checklist shape before a production release window without executing deployment, rollback, SQL, or reading secret values.

requiredChecklistFields.name: release-operator
requiredChecklistFields.description: Operator records who is responsible for the release handoff.

requiredChecklistFields.name: rollback-approver
requiredChecklistFields.description: Operator records who can approve rollback during the release window.

requiredChecklistFields.name: artifact-target
requiredChecklistFields.description: Operator records the exact release tag or artifact version selected for handoff.

requiredChecklistFields.name: database-migration-direction
requiredChecklistFields.description: Operator records whether this release is forward-only, rollback-script-reviewed, or no-database-change.

requiredChecklistFields.name: secret-source-confirmation
requiredChecklistFields.description: Operator confirms the production secret source contract without exposing secret values.

requiredChecklistFields.name: deployment-runbook-contract
requiredChecklistFields.description: Operator confirms the deployment runbook contract without triggering deployment.

requiredChecklistFields.name: rollback-approval-record-fixture
requiredChecklistFields.description: Operator confirms the rollback approval record fixture used by the handoff review.

requiredChecklistFields.name: release-audit-retention-fixture
requiredChecklistFields.description: Operator confirms the release audit retention fixture used by the later retention gate.

requiredChecklistFields.name: release-operator-signoff-fixture
requiredChecklistFields.description: Operator confirms the release operator signoff fixture used by approval prerequisite checks.

requiredChecklistFields.name: no-secret-value-boundary
requiredChecklistFields.description: Operator confirms this checklist stores metadata only and never embeds secret values.

noSecretValueBoundaries: Secret values must not be read by Java or Node when rendering this checklist
Secret values must not be embedded in handoff checklist JSON
Node may render the release handoff review only
forbiddenOperations: Executing Java deployment from this fixture
Executing Java rollback from this fixture
Executing database rollback SQL from this fixture
Connecting production database from this fixture
Reading production secret values from this fixture
Embedding secret values in handoff checklist JSON
